mapper.select: select id, email::text as email, display_name, password_hash, status, locale, timezone, version, created_by, created_at, updated_at, last_login_at from iam.user_account where email = #{email} limit 1
select id, email::text as email, display_name, password_hash, status, locale, timezone, version, created_by, created_at, updated_at, last_login_at from iam.user_account where id = #{id}
select r.code from iam.user_role ur join iam.role r on r.id = ur.role_id where ur.user_id = #{userId} order by r.code
select distinct p.code from iam.user_role ur join iam.role_permission rp on rp.role_id = ur.role_id join iam.permission p on p.id = rp.permission_id where ur.user_id = #{userId} order by p.code
mapper.update: update iam.user_account set last_login_at = now(), updated_at = now() where id = #{userId}
mapper.select: select id, code_hash, created_by, default_role, max_uses, used_count, expires_at, status, version, created_at from iam.invitation_code where code_hash = #{codeHash} for update
mapper.update: update iam.invitation_code set used_count = used_count + 1, status = case when used_count + 1 >= max_uses then 'EXHAUSTED' else status end, version = version + 1 where id = #{id} and version = #{version} and status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: select u.id, u.email::text as email, u.display_name, u.status, coalesce(string_agg(r.code, ',' order by r.code), '') as roles, u.created_at, u.last_login_at from iam.user_account u left join iam.user_role ur on ur.user_id = u.id left join iam.role r on r.id = ur.role_id group by u.id order by u.created_at desc, u.id desc limit #{limit}

select id, default_role, max_uses, used_count, expires_at, case when status = 'ACTIVE' and expires_at < now() then 'EXPIRED' else status end as status, created_at from iam.invitation_code order by created_at desc, id desc limit #{limit}
